content:
- Model consistently overestimates prices in early forecast windows, especially after recent spikes; apply downward bias correction for first 5–7 days.
- After a price spike, model tends to overshoot and fail to correct downward quickly; reduce forecast slope after peak to reflect mean reversion.
- When sentiment is neutral (all 0.00), model exhibits high volatility and overconfidence; dampen forecast variance and anchor to recent 7-day moving average.
- Forecast horizon 30d shows persistent lag in capturing sharp downward trends; add 1–2 day lag correction for sudden drops.
- If true outcome shows early sharp decline (e.g., 48.22 → 46.63), model fails to anticipate; adjust for “early drop” by reducing forecast by 10–15% in first 3 days.
- Model underestimates low-end of price range in late forecast window; add 2–3% upward bias for final 5–7 days to account for rebound potential.
